The offline schema fixture is the OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 schema, downloaded from
https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/cos02/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
on 2026-09-11. Only line endings are normalized. It is maintained by OASIS;
see https://www.oasis-open.org/policies-guidelines/ipr/ for OASIS document terms.
Tests do not fetch schemas or resolve remote references.
